scripts.text:
[Noi]
Welcome to Ayothaya.
Our beautiful village is built
above the water, surrounded
by a dense forest.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
欢迎来到哎哟泰雅。
我们美丽的村庄建在水面上，
四周被茂密的森林环绕。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
There are many tourist attractions in this village that you won't be able to find anywhere else. Our fish markets and the unique architecture of our buildings are enough reason to visit Ayotaya.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
这个村庄有许多您在别处找不到的旅游景点。我们的鱼市和独特的建筑风格，足以让您专程前来哎哟泰雅。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Please feel free
to take a look around.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
请随意四处看看。

scripts.text: Building Locations.
scripts.translation: 查看建筑位置

scripts.text: Remove marks from mini-map.
scripts.translation: 移除小地图标记

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Where would
you like to visit?
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
您想去哪里参观？

scripts.text: Weapon Shop
scripts.translation: 武器店

scripts.text: Tool Shop
scripts.translation: 工具店

scripts.text: Tavern
scripts.translation: 酒馆

scripts.text: Shrine
scripts.translation: 神龛

scripts.text: Fishing Spot
scripts.translation: 钓鱼点

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Noi]
At our Weapon Shop,
you will find great weapons
favored by brave Ayothayan seafarers.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
在我们的武器店，
您能找到深受勇敢的哎哟泰雅航海者喜爱的优质武器。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Our Weapon Shop
is located at ^55FF33+^000000.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
我们的武器店
位于 ^55FF33+^000000。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
We Ayothayans always make sure we have everything we need before we go traveling. It never hurts to be prepared, doesn't it?
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
我们哎哟泰雅人在出行前总会确保备齐所需物品。有备无患，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Our Tool Shop
is located at ^3355FF+^000000.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
我们的工具店
位于 ^3355FF+^000000。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
One of the basics of adventuring is gathering information, or at least that's what they say. You can meet people from all sorts of places in the Tavern. I'm sure you can learn something useful there.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
冒险的基本功之一就是收集情报，至少人们是这么说的。您可以在酒馆里结识来自各地的人。我相信您在那里一定能学到一些有用的东西。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Of course, you must
drop by our Tavern.
It is located at ^00FF00+^000000.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
当然，您一定要来我们的酒馆坐坐。
它位于 ^00FF00+^000000。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
If you wish to pray to God, or achieve a state of peace in your mind, why don't you visit our Shrine? Even if it's just for sight-seeing, everyone is
welcome there.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
如果您想向神明祈祷，或者寻求内心的平静，不妨来参观我们的神龛。即使只是观光，那里也欢迎所有人。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Our Shrine
is located at ^00FF00+^000000.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
我们的神龛
位于 ^00FF00+^000000。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Since Ayothaya was built above the surface of the water and close to a beach, it's been a favorite spot for fishermen. Why don't you catch some fish for dinner at the Fishing Spot?
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
由于哎哟泰雅建在水面上且靠近海滩，这里一直是渔民的热门地点。您不妨去钓鱼点钓些鱼作为晚餐？

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Our famous
Fishing Spot
is located at ^00FF00+^000000
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
我们著名的
钓鱼点
位于 ^00FF00+^000000

scripts.text:
[Noi]
If you wish to remove location marks on your mini-map, please select the 'Remove marks from mini-map' command from the menu.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
如果您想移除小地图上的位置标记，请从菜单中选择“移除小地图标记”命令。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Alright...
I've removed all the
location marks from
your mini-map.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
好的...
我已经移除了
您小地图上
所有的标记。
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Noi]
Please enjoy
your travels.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
祝您旅途愉快。
